short_description: Private guided bike tour from the Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito with a bonus all-day bike rental.
description:
Enjoy a small private tour with just your party and our tour guide. Best way to safely enjoy seeing the many sights of San Francisco. 

This private experience includes customized start time, private tour guide, personalized information given based on your group needs and bonus all day bike rental! 


Enjoy a small private tour for just your party and a dedicated guide as you pedal from the Golden Gate Bridge into sunny Sausalito. The experience is customized to your group with a private guide who provides personalized commentary and adapts the route and information to your interests. After exploring Sausalito’s shops and lunch options, guests have the option to return via ferry (ferry ticket sold separately). This beginner-friendly outing is ideal for families and riders of all ages.

what_is_included_items.value: 3-hour guided bike tour with personalized attention from your expert guide, offering insights on SF landmarks
Personalized commentary based on group needs

what_is_not_included_items.value: Ferry tickets from Sausalito (Folks may return to San Francisco by riding back)
Optional gratuities for the tour guide

itinerary:
Guided Bike Tour with Bay City Bike Rentals and Tours (Up to 3 hours):

* Meet your guide at 📍 2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER in Fisherman’s Wharf
* Bike fitting and safety orientation
* Fisherman’s Wharf waterfront
* Pass through the Marina District
* Palace of Fine Arts Theatre (photo stop)
* Ride along Crissy Field
* Break stop at Warming Hut Cafe (bathroom & coffee break)
* Visit Fort Point National Historic Site
* Cross the Golden Gate Bridge (photo stop)
* Vista Point for panoramic views (photo stop)
* Tour ends in Sausalito ferry terminal
* Sausalito – explore waterfront restaurants, cafés, and return options
* Return to 📍 2661 Taylor Street
highlights:
* Private guided bike tour on the iconic Golden Gate Bridge route
* Flexible start time to fit your schedule
* Fixed scenic route with waterfront views and landmark stops
* Personalized pace, photo stops, and local commentary
* Explore Sausalito before returning by bike or ferry (tickets not included)
check_in_details: Check-in 30 minutes before the tour and meet your guide at 2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER in Fisherman’s Wharf.
special_requirements:
All riders are required to sign a liability waiver prior to riding. Guests under 18 must have a parent or legal guardian present to sign on their behalf and accompany them at check-in.

If you book online, you’ll receive an electronic waiver to complete in advance. Walk-in guests will complete the waiver during check-in before the rental begins.
disclaimers: Ferry return requires a separate ticket. Tour is described as beginner level and family friendly; specifics about fitness, equipment restrictions, or minimum participants were not provided.

faq_items.question: What time does the tour leave?
faq_items.answer: The tour departs at your selected start time. Guests may choose from 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 1:00 PM, 2:00 PM, 3:00 PM, 4:00 PM, or 5:00 PM. We ask all guests to arrive at least 30 minutes early to complete paperwork and get fitted for their bike. The tour covers approximately 8 miles and lasts 2.5 - 3 hours. All tours depart from our Fisherman’s Wharf Tour Center, located at 2661 Taylor Street.

faq_items.question: What's included with a Bay City Bike guided bike tour of San Francisco?
faq_items.answer: In addition to fabulous routes led by local guides, we provide your bike rental, helmet, a front camera bag, bells, maps and map holders, water bottle holders, and locks. We also have kid equipment options.

faq_items.question: How long does it take to bike over the Golden Gate Bridge?
faq_items.answer: Biking across the Golden Gate Bridge typically takes 10–15 minutes one way, depending on your pace, wind conditions, and how often you stop for photos. Our Golden Gate Bridge bike tours allow plenty of time to enjoy the views, learn about the bridge’s history, and take photos along the way.

faq_items.question: Is San Francisco all hilly cycling?
faq_items.answer: Not at all. While some neighborhoods are steep, many of the most popular cycling routes are surprisingly flat. Our San Francisco bike tours are carefully designed to avoid major climbs and instead follow scenic, mostly level paths along the waterfront, parks, and bike-friendly corridors. For extra comfort, we offer electric bike tours of SF to make hills effortless.

faq_items.question: How long is the bike ride from SF to Sausalito?
faq_items.answer: The bike ride from San Francisco to Sausalito is about 8 miles one way and usually takes 60–90 minutes at a relaxed touring pace. This iconic route crosses the Golden Gate Bridge and continues along a mostly downhill ride into Sausalito, making it one of the most popular routes featured on San Francisco bike tours.

faq_items.question: Is Bay City Bike open daily?
faq_items.answer: We are open 365 days a year, rain or shine. We suggest booking your tour ahead of time though, as spots can fill up quick. We also offer a 20% discount if you book online!

faq_items.question: Is there a bike path across the Golden Gate Bridge?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The Golden Gate Bridge has dedicated bike access, with cyclists sharing one side of the bridge depending on the day and time. The path is clearly marked and well-maintained. Our Golden Gate Bridge tours provide up-to-date guidance on which side to ride and ensure a safe, stress-free crossing.

faq_items.question: Are Electric bikes necessary for this tour?
faq_items.answer: Electric bikes are not necessary but very helpful! They are pedal assist bikes that give you a boost as you go uphill/while you ride. It is certainly doable without the electric bike, but there are a few hills along the way. Those who use an electric bike will be able to zip up the hill with no problem!

faq_items.question: Do we take the ferry back to the city? Are the ferry tickets included?
faq_items.answer: Ferry available in Sausalito for the Golden Gate Bridge to Sausalito tour for an extra cost; riders can also leave bikes in Sausalito, post-tour, for a fee (we will help on day-of, just call from Sausalito!)
